purpose: Presentation-only ESO gear, skill, passive, and Champion Point history. Never used by mechanics/runtime calculations.

events.name: Serpent's Disdain
events.summary: Released with a 5-piece bonus that increases the duration of Status Effects you apply by 16 seconds.
events.source: ZOS PC/Mac Patch Notes v8.0.5 - High Isle & Update 34

events.name: Pillager's Profit
events.summary: Released with its Ultimate-support 5-piece granting 5% of Ultimate spent per tick, up to 20 Ultimate, to as many as 11 nearby group members over 10 seconds, with a 45-second recipient cooldown.
events.source: ZOS PC/Mac Patch Notes v8.0.5 - High Isle & Update 34

events.name: Pillager's Profit
events.summary: Fixed the set so its Ultimate-support effect no longer targets pets, which cannot receive Ultimate.
events.source: ZOS PC/Mac Patch Notes v9.1.5 - Update 39

events.name: Pillager's Profit
events.summary: Ultimate granted per tick was reduced to 2% of Ultimate spent, down from 5%.
events.source: ZOS PC/Mac Patch Notes v11.0.5 - Update 46

events.name: Roaring Opportunist
events.summary: Released from Kyne's Aegis with a fully charged Heavy Attack trigger that granted Major Slayer to up to 11 group members. Duration scaled from the triggering Heavy Attack's damage, with a 5-second minimum, 12-second maximum, and 22-second target lockout.
events.source: ZOS PC/Mac Patch Notes v6.0.5 - Greymoor & Update 26

events.name: Roaring Opportunist
events.summary: Group targets were reduced from 12 to 6, and Major Slayer duration changed from Heavy Attack damage scaling to scaling from the caster's Spell Damage and Max Magicka.
events.source: ZOS PC/Mac Patch Notes v6.1.5 - Stonethorn & Update 27

events.name: Roaring Opportunist
events.summary: The 2-piece bonus changed to 129 Weapon and Spell Damage from 1487 Offensive Penetration.
events.source: ZOS PC/Mac Patch Notes v11.1.5 - Update 47

events.name: Saxhleel Champion
events.summary: Released with Rockgrove. Casting an Ultimate granted Major Force to the caster and up to 11 group members within 28 meters for 1 second per 15 Ultimate spent, while in combat.
events.source: ZOS PC/Mac Patch Notes v7.0.5 - Blackwood & Update 30

events.name: Pearlescent Ward
events.summary: Released with Dreadsail Reef. Its 5-piece scaled group Weapon and Spell Damage with living group members and scaled non-player damage reduction with dead group members.
events.source: ZOS PC/Mac Patch Notes v8.0.5 - High Isle & Update 34

events.name: Spell Power Cure
events.summary: During the Imperial City release cycle, the set's proc was expanded to apply to Weapon Power in addition to Spell Power.
events.source: ZOS PTS Patch Notes v2.1.3

events.name: Spell Power Cure
events.summary: Changed from a 50% proc chance when healing a target at full Health to guaranteed Major Courage when overhealing; the 6-person target cap was also removed.
events.source: ZOS PC/Mac Patch Notes v6.1.5 - Stonethorn & Update 27

events.name: Powerful Assault
events.summary: During the Imperial City release cycle, the set's 5-piece Weapon and Spell Damage bonus was increased by 35%.
events.source: ZOS PTS Patch Notes v2.1.2

events.name: Powerful Assault
events.summary: Changed from 164 Weapon and Spell Damage to allies within 15 meters for 15 seconds to 307 Weapon and Spell Damage to group members within 10 meters for 10 seconds.
events.source: ZOS PC/Mac Patch Notes v6.1.5 - Stonethorn & Update 27

events.name: Turning Tide
events.summary: Released with Shipwright's Regret. Blocking granted Flowing Water for 10 seconds; the next Bash dealt Magic Damage to up to 6 enemies in a 5 by 10 meter line and applied Major Vulnerability for 10 seconds, with a 15-second cooldown.
events.source: ZOS PC/Mac Patch Notes v7.3.5 - Ascending Tide & Update 33

events.name: Turning Tide
events.summary: A post-launch patch fixed the set's damage so it correctly respected its own cooldown.
events.source: ZOS PC/Mac Patch Notes v7.3.6

events.name: Nazaray
events.summary: Released with Shipwright's Regret. Using an Ultimate extended Major and Minor debuffs on the closest 6 enemies within 12 meters by 1 second per 20 Ultimate spent, with a 30-second per-target cooldown; damage beams and tethers were excluded.
events.source: ZOS PC/Mac Patch Notes v7.3.5 - Ascending Tide & Update 33

events.name: Spaulder of Ruin
events.summary: Released with Deadlands. Crouching toggled a 12-meter Aura of Pride that granted up to 6 allies 260 Weapon and Spell Damage while reducing the wearer's Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery by 70 for each ally benefiting.
events.source: ZOS PC/Mac Patch Notes v7.2.5 - Deadlands & Update 32

events.name: Elemental Catalyst
events.summary: Released with Stone Garden. Flame, Shock, and Frost damage applied matching 3-second Weakness stacks; each distinct elemental stack increased the target's Critical Damage taken by 3%, with one stack of each element allowed.
events.source: ZOS PC/Mac Patch Notes v6.1.5 - Stonethorn & Update 27

events.name: Elemental Catalyst
events.summary: Its visual effects were changed to display only to the wearer and enemies, reducing group-combat visual clutter without changing the set's combat effect.
events.source: ZOS High Isle & Update 34 patch notes

events.name: Z'en's Redress
events.summary: Released with Lair of Maarselok. Light Attacks applied Touch of Z'en for 20 seconds; the target took 1% additional damage for each damage-over-time effect placed by the wearer, up to 5%.
events.source: ZOS PC/Mac Patch Notes v5.1.5 - Scalebreaker & Update 23

events.name: Combat Prayer
events.summary: Healing was increased as part of the Restoration Staff healing pass; rank progression changed from added healing efficiency to reduced cost, and Minor Berserk stopped applying to pets because pets already inherit their owner's Minor Berserk.
events.source: ZOS PC/Mac Patch Notes v5.1.5 - Scalebreaker & Update 23

events.name: Essence Drain
events.summary: Major Mending duration increased to 2/4 seconds from 1.5/3; the friendly-heal search range increased to 12 meters from 6; healing increased to 25/50% of Heavy Attack damage from 15/30%; a double-critical-strike issue was also fixed.
events.source: ZOS PC/Mac Patch Notes v7.1.5 - Waking Flame & Update 31

events.name: Fighting Finesse
events.summary: Changed to 4% Critical Damage and Critical Healing per stage with two 25-point stages, replacing the previous 2% per stage with five 10-point stages.
events.source: ZOS High Isle & Update 34 patch notes
